mechanics.claim: Cultivation of Spirit's active attack resets Yunara's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Cultivation of Spirit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The active gives a 40% lower attack windup and an uncancellable windup, in addition to increased missile speed.
mechanics.quote: augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time, and an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: Spread attacks apply life steal and on-hit effects and can critically strike if the triggering attack does.
mechanics.quote: Each spread attack {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will {{tip|critically strike}} if the triggering attack does.

mechanics.claim: The passive/active on-hit damage will critically strike for 0% bonus damage when the triggering attack does, so it is not increased by crit but is reduced by Randuin's Omen.

mechanics.claim: There is no limit to the number of enemies the empowered attacks can spread to.

mechanics.claim: While inactive, basic attacks generate a stack of Unleash which refreshes on subsequent attacks; the ability has no cooldown but a minimum downtime determined by attack speed and stack generation.
mechanics.quote: While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' has no cooldown, the ability has a minimum downtime that is the time it takes for '''Yunara''' to generate 8 stacks.
